tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Tenders from Joint ventures are not acceptable.
Conditional tenders will not be accepted
Before Quoting the rates tenderer should read the bid document carefully
The Tender Processing Fee shall not be refundable
The Employer reserves the rights to Reject or accept any or all the tenders without assigning any reasons
Bidders should abide to all the Terms and Conditions attached.
Ensure that all required documents are uploaded in accordance with the tender document.
The bidder should mention the UDIN No. on the turnover certificate, failing which bid is rejected.

To qualify for award of this contract, each Tenderer in its name should have in the last five years i.e.2021-22 ,2022-23, 2023-24 ,2024-25 & 2025-26 (b) satisfactorily completed as prime contractor, at least Similler Nature of Work
If the bidder uploaded the false document while participating in the tender, the bidder will be responsible and action will be initiated as per the tender clause.
The Department is not responsible for any delay in accessing kppp portal.

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Annual Turnover Certificate with UDIN from CA & IT Returns in the last five years i.e. 2021-22, 2022-23 , 2023-24 , 2024-25 & 2025-25
Class-II and above Electrical inspectorate Registration Certificate
Credit lines/ letters of credit/ certificates from banks
Similar services to Government agencies Qualification and experience
Upload relevant documents as per tender document
